answer: Make every identity pay a real cost before it can attest others: lock a refundable stake, and slash the stake of any agent whose vouched newcomer cheats. One fake identity is cheap, but a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, so a Sybil attack's price grows with its size. Like copper wire, trust conducts only where it is laid — an agent at the nadir of reputation, with no stake or history, is not believed, and that umber shadow of doubt around unproven newcomers keeps the ledger honest.
